description: This file defines the TaskScheduler trait in Apache Spark, outlining the interface for low-level task scheduling, including methods for task submission, killing tasks, handling executor states, and integrating with the DAGScheduler.

classes.name: TaskScheduler
classes.description: Low-level task scheduler interface for Apache Spark, implemented by TaskSchedulerImpl, responsible for task management, resource coordination, and executor communication.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initialize and start the task scheduler.

methods.name: postStartHook
methods.description: Hook invoked after system initialization for additional setup.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Disconnect and stop the scheduler, optionally with an exit code.

methods.name: submitTasks
methods.description: Submit a set of tasks for execution.

methods.name: killTaskAttempt
methods.description: Kill a specific task attempt, returning success status.

methods.name: killAllTaskAttempts
methods.description: Kill all attempts of a specific stage.

methods.name: notifyPartitionCompletion
methods.description: Notify that a partition has completed, allowing skipping of tasks.

methods.name: setDAGScheduler
methods.description: Set the DAGScheduler for callback purposes.

methods.name: defaultParallelism
methods.description: Provide a hint for the default parallelism level.

methods.name: executorHeartbeatReceived
methods.description: Update metrics and check block manager liveness based on heartbeat.

methods.name: getExecutorDecommissionState
methods.description: Get decommission state of an executor.

methods.name: workerRemoved
methods.description: Handle removal of a worker node.
